findings.title: Runtime registers event OnActionAdded absent from the current engine event registry
findings.reproduction_evidence: The current PZCodebase event registry contains 270 names but not OnActionAdded; UTMods registers it at 2 call site(s).
findings.recommended_correction: Use the current engine event name and contract, or implement an explicit project-owned event producer.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Build the engine event set and assert OnActionAdded is registered before any Events.OnActionAdded.Add call is accepted.

findings.smallest_regression_test: Hash every relative source/release media file and require empty missing, extra, and content-mismatch sets.

findings.title: Translator preprocessing mutates literal percent signs in English descriptions
anchors: UTMods/UniversalTraits/media/lua/shared/Translate/EN/UI.json (keys: UI_UT_actionheroDesc, UI_UT_adaptivemetabolismDesc, UI_UT_antigunDesc, UI_UT_antiqueDesc, UI_UT_asceticDesc, UI_UT_axesDesc, UI_UT_burnedDesc, UI_UT_cleaverDesc, UI_UT_driverDesc, UI_UT_durabilityDesc, UI_UT_evasiveDesc, UI_UT_fastDesc, UI_UT_fasthandsDesc, UI_UT_flateartherDesc, UI_UT_gimpDesc, UI_UT_glassbodyDesc, UI_UT_gordaniteDesc, UI_UT_gourmandDesc, UI_UT_heavilybleedingwoundsDesc, UI_UT_idealweightDesc, UI_UT_improviserDesc, UI_UT_indefatigableDesc, UI_UT_ironliverDesc, UI_UT_leadfootDesc, UI_UT_long_bladesDesc, UI_UT_long_bluntsDesc, UI_UT_ludditeDesc, UI_UT_lurcherDesc, UI_UT_martialDesc, UI_UT_mundaneDesc, UI_UT_naturalDesc, UI_UT_noodlelegsDesc, UI_UT_onehanded_axesDesc, UI_UT_onehanded_bladesDesc, UI_UT_onehanded_bluntsDesc, UI_UT_pacerDesc, UI_UT_paramedicDesc, UI_UT_photographicmemoryDesc, UI_UT_pitcrewDesc, UI_UT_prospearDesc, UI_UT_quickworkerDesc, UI_UT_restfulsleeperDesc, UI_UT_scroungerDesc, UI_UT_sharpshooterDesc, UI_UT_short_bladesDesc, UI_UT_short_bluntsDesc, UI_UT_slackDesc, UI_UT_slowworkerDesc, UI_UT_sorelegsDesc, UI_UT_thickbloodDesc, UI_UT_twohanded_axesDesc, UI_UT_twohanded_bladesDesc, UI_UT_twohanded_bluntsDesc, UI_UT_unwaveringDesc, UI_UT_weaklybleedingwoundsDesc, UI_UT_wildsmanDesc)
findings.reproduction_evidence: Applying the current two-step Translator replacement changes 56 no-argument descriptions.
findings.recommended_correction: Encode literal percent signs using the Translator-safe representation verified for this game build.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Load every flagged key through the current Translator path without format arguments and compare the rendered text byte-for-byte with intended copy.
